title: Oxygen14 pinned-source 400 W 0–100 us chemistry-OFF P0/P1/P2 ONLY (no full solve)

stages.name: Restore immutable Oxygen14 source and stage original 400W input deterministically
command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$PWD" = "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
SOURCE="$PWD/.issue457_pinned_oxygen14"
test ! -e "$SOURCE"
git init -q "$SOURCE"
git -C "$SOURCE" remote add origin https://github.com/HyungseonSong-plasma/moose-test-repo.git
git -C "$SOURCE" fetch -q --depth=1 origin 29d1acc6ef7969908b86719e4b95c73a1565136d
git -C "$SOURCE" checkout -q --detach FETCH_HEAD
test "$(git -C "$SOURCE" rev-parse HEAD)" = "29d1acc6ef7969908b86719e4b95c73a1565136d"
python3 -m venv .issue457_venv
.issue457_venv/bin/python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --quiet numpy==2.1.2 scipy==1.14.1
cd "$SOURCE"
export OXYGEN_RESEARCH_400=1
export CHATGPT_WORK_BASE_SHA=29d1acc6ef7969908b86719e4b95c73a1565136d
export PYTHONPATH="$OLDPWD"
"$OLDPWD/.issue457_venv/bin/python" -m pytest -q "$OLDPWD/tests/test_oxygen_c0_chemistry_off.py" "$OLDPWD/tests/test_oxygen_c0_profile_exodus.py"
source "$OLDPWD/.issue457_venv/bin/activate"
bash experiments/Issue395_powered_chemistry_ladder/issue397_l1_power_scan_replay.sh prepare 400
python3 .github/scripts/oxygen_legacy6_latest_100us.py --power-w 400 --prepare
mkdir -p experiments/Issue395_powered_chemistry_ladder/c0_400_p2_preflight
python3 "$OLDPWD/bin/physics.py" oxygen-c0 --root "$SOURCE" --base-input "$SOURCE/experiments/Issue395_powered_chemistry_ladder/rf_elastic_diss_ion_ei20_ei01_400w_adjacent_sheath_wall_closed_100us_dt1000ns.i" --rf-parent "$SOURCE/experiments/Issue395_powered_chemistry_ladder/rf_elastic_multiapp_parent_400w_100us_dt1000ns_overlay.i" --output "$SOURCE/experiments/Issue395_powered_chemistry_ladder/c0_400_p2_preflight/c0_manifest.json"
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, hashlib
r=pathlib.Path("experiments/Issue395_powered_chemistry_ladder/c0_400_p2_preflight")
m=json.loads((r/"c0_manifest.json").read_text())
assert m["source_harness_expected_sha"]=="29d1acc6ef7969908b86719e4b95c73a1565136d"
assert m["original_base_sha256"]=="9ac3269b3f59390946045fd061dbaa85a00e8afde31de1f1cb9150e5e0ad61a4", "historical generated input not byte-identical to native 400W archive"
assert m["active_cli_input_files"]==["experiments/Issue395_powered_chemistry_ladder/rf_elastic_diss_ion_ei20_ei01_400w_adjacent_sheath_wall_closed_100us_dt1000ns__C0_chemistry_off.i","experiments/Issue395_powered_chemistry_ladder/rf_elastic_multiapp_parent_400w_100us_dt1000ns_overlay.i"]
assert len(m["removed_reactive_wall_objects"])==15
assert m["phase"]=="P0_STATIC_CANDIDATE_ONLY"
print("ISSUE457_C0_400_SOURCE_P0_PASS")
PY

stages.name: Build native PhysicsApp from original pinned source and immutable build image
command:
set -euo pipefail
cd .issue457_pinned_oxygen14
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "29d1acc6ef7969908b86719e4b95c73a1565136d"
export OXYGEN_RESEARCH_400=1 CHATGPT_WORK_BASE_SHA=29d1acc6ef7969908b86719e4b95c73a1565136d
bash experiments/Issue395_powered_chemistry_ladder/issue397_l1_power_scan_replay.sh build 400
test -x physics_app/physics-opt
echo ISSUE457_C0_400_NATIVE_BUILD_P1_PASS

stages.name: Actual native PhysicsApp check-input for exactly two C0 inputs
command:
set -euo pipefail
cd .issue457_pinned_oxygen14
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "29d1acc6ef7969908b86719e4b95c73a1565136d"
INPUT="experiments/Issue395_powered_chemistry_ladder/rf_elastic_diss_ion_ei20_ei01_400w_adjacent_sheath_wall_closed_100us_dt1000ns__C0_chemistry_off.i"
PARENT="experiments/Issue395_powered_chemistry_ladder/rf_elastic_multiapp_parent_400w_100us_dt1000ns_overlay.i"
RESULT="experiments/Issue395_powered_chemistry_ladder/c0_400_p2_preflight"
test -s "$INPUT" && test -s "$PARENT"
test -s "$RESULT/c0_manifest.json"
IMAGE="ghcr.io/hyungseonsong-plasma/physics-build-base@sha256:2c3352da4f5c1b2ae98475fc01463ad0cdbc6ce7d221ce55055ddea152182008"
docker run --rm --entrypoint /bin/bash --user 0:0 --workdir /workspace -v "$PWD:/workspace" "$IMAGE" -lc "set -euo pipefail; source /environment; physics_app/physics-opt --check-input -i '$INPUT' '$PARENT'" 2>&1 | tee "$RESULT/check_input.log"
grep -Eq '^(.*Input file.*syntax.*|.*Parsing.*complete.*|.*Simulation.*setup.*)' "$RESULT/check_input.log" || test -s "$RESULT/check_input.log"
echo ISSUE457_C0_400_NATIVE_CHECK_INPUT_P2_PASS
